about: One row per check or known failure, per client, with its evidence class and the date of the client behaviour it describes. Labels: blocker = our own run confirmed it; likely = the platform documents it; advisory = seen in a run, but the shape alone does not predict it, or friction rather than failure; info = a client property, not a server finding; unconfirmed = listed as not checked, never shown as a finding. Each run case carries its date, the text a report shows, and a public link where one exists; the run records themselves are not published.

rules.title: Required fields inside the rows of a required top-level array
rules.detects: A required top-level array input whose object rows list required fields.
rules.fix: Do not mark fields inside rows as required; check them in your handler. Or take the array as a JSON string.

copilot-studio.label: blocker
copilot-studio.says: On Standard agents, Copilot asks the user for row fields the model already filled, and never calls the tool.

copilot-studio.note: Standard agents only. On 2026-10-20 Studio's newer Agent (GitHub Copilot) type, the one its main Agent card makes, called this shape 6 of 6 (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5.5 Chat); Standard agents 0 of 6 (GPT Chat Latest, Claude Opus 4.8).

cases.report: monday create_items through Anthropic's connector: passed outside Copilot (6 of 6 with GPT)
monday create_items through OpenAI's MCP tool: passed outside Copilot

rules.title: A required top-level array whose items have no type

cases.report: Lucid org chart through Anthropic's connector: 3 of 3
Lucid org chart through OpenAI's MCP tool: 3 of 3

rules.title: Eight or more required inputs on one tool
rules.detects: A tool whose input schema lists eight or more required properties.
rules.fix: Require only what you cannot default.

copilot-studio.label: blocker

cases.report: monday after1: Claude through Anthropic's connector filled all eight required search inputs and passed

rules.title: More than 70 tools
rules.detects: tools/list has more than 70 tools; reports which sit past position 70.
rules.fix: Put the tools behind your users' main jobs first. If you have more than 70, choose which 70 Copilot users get.

copilot-studio.label: advisory
copilot-studio.says: On some servers a classic Copilot agent keeps only the first 70 tools; a needed tool past the cut is invisible.

cases.report: monday by URL: 74 of 97 listed, banner 'Limiting number of tools to 70'
monday search at #85: GPT in Copilot 0 of 3
a sales-data vendor's 86 tools, all listed by URL with no banner (counter-case)
a marketing vendor's 282 tools, all listed by Copilot's new default agent (counter-case)

copilot-studio.note: Sources disagree: Zuplo lists 128 as Copilot Studio's cap (2026-07-31); Microsoft's page lists none. Never read this as 'Copilot keeps 70'.

rules.title: Array rows with optional keys
rules.detects: An array of objects whose rows declare properties that are not required, or take free extra keys.
rules.fix: Give every row the same keys; use an empty value where a row has nothing.

copilot-studio.label: advisory
copilot-studio.says: Copilot sends every row with the first row's keys only; it fails only when the rows differ.

cases.report: an opening-hours tool: rows lost the keys they needed, 0 of 3
a CRM's note and task in one call: the task arrived blank
Lucid after its fix (rows still optional): 6 of 6 (counter-case)

rules.title: An object with no declared properties
rules.detects: type object (or a row) with no properties and additionalProperties not false.
rules.fix: Declare the common properties, or take name/value rows.

copilot-studio.label: advisory
copilot-studio.says: Copilot types a free map as an empty record; keys survive in the first row only.

cases.report: a CRM's free-form properties map: the second row lost its keys

rules.title: The F1-ROW or UNTYPED shape in an optional or nested array
rules.detects: Required row fields, or untyped items, in an array that is optional or nested inside an object.
rules.fix: As for F1-ROW and UNTYPED.

copilot-studio.label: advisory
copilot-studio.says: Unconfirmed: in one CRM we ran, required row fields one level down caused no handback.

cases.report: a CRM's required row fields one level down: no handback (counter-case)

rules.title: A delete tool not annotated destructiveHint: true
rules.detects: A tool named delete/remove/destroy/purge/erase whose annotations do not say destructiveHint: true.
rules.fix: Annotate delete tools as destructive, and keep them out of a default tool set.

claude-api.label: unconfirmed
claude-api.note: Related, not this shape: deletes behind Apideck's single execute_tool, 7 of 15 'clean up' runs deleted deals (DELETE-ON-CLEANUP).

claude-api.says: A cost: a server with 282 tools cost $0.94 for one simple job.

rules.fix: Use one type; express optional through required.

rules.fix: List the allowed values in the description too.

rules.detects: The registry entry's URL has one host per tenant or region.
rules.fix: None needed; the owner gives the real URL to this tool.

rules.title: Two or more required credential headers
rules.detects: The server needs two or more credential headers (from the registry entry, or from the credentials the owner passes).
rules.fix: Accept the second value in the URL or inside the key.

rules.title: Credentials by API key only, no OAuth

rules.fix: Offer OAuth for interface clients.

rules.title: Copilot cannot find the protected-resource document
rules.detects: A tokenless GET gets no 401 naming a protected-resource document, the path-form document is not served, and no authorization-server metadata is on the MCP host.
rules.fix: Send your 401 challenge to a GET too, or serve the document at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/<path>, or serve the metadata on the MCP host.

copilot-studio.label: blocker
copilot-studio.says: 'Failed to login. Could not discover authorization server metadata.'

rules.title: Only one of the two OAuth documents on the MCP host
rules.detects: The protected-resource document is on the MCP host and the metadata only on the auth host, or the other way round.
rules.fix: None needed for Copilot.

cases.report: our test server: Copilot followed the document to the auth host, 3 of 3
a sales-tool vendor: the path-form document missing, metadata on the host; discovery passed

rules.title: The first authorization server in the document does not work

rules.fix: Put the working authorization server first.

copilot-studio.label: unconfirmed

rules.title: No client registration and no client metadata documents
rules.detects: The authorization server's metadata has no registration_endpoint and does not support CIMD.
rules.fix: Offer dynamic client registration or client ID metadata documents.

rules.title: S256 not advertised
rules.detects: code_challenge_methods_supported does not list S256.

copilot-studio.label: unconfirmed

rules.title: Which redirect URI ChatGPT will use
rules.detects: Whether the authorization server advertises authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported (RFC 9207).
rules.fix: Allow the redirect URI that matches your setting.

chatgpt.label: info
chatgpt.says: Without RFC 9207 iss, ChatGPT uses https://chatgpt.com/connector/oauth/{callback_id} instead of https://chatgpt.com/connector_platform_oauth_redirect.

rules.title: Client registration refuses a client's redirect URI
rules.detects: With --register (your own server only): dynamic client registration with each client's redirect URI.
rules.fix: Allow each client's redirect URI, including https://global.consent.azure-apim.net/redirect and its per-connector form.

copilot-studio.label: blocker
copilot-studio.says: 'GetDynamicClientRegistrationResultAsync failed … invalid_redirect_uri'

cases.report: a CRM vendor's registration accepted Claude, ChatGPT and localhost, and refused both Microsoft URIs (guide §6)

chatgpt.label: likely

rules.title: An authorization request without scope is refused
rules.detects: The authorization request as Copilot builds it, with no scope, followed up to the login page: an error first.
rules.fix: Give requests without a scope a default, or name the scope in WWW-Authenticate.

copilot-studio.label: blocker

copilot-studio.label: blocker

rules.title: anyOf, oneOf or allOf at the root of an input schema
rules.detects: A combinator keyword at the top level of inputSchema.
rules.fix: Put a plain object at the root and move alternatives into properties.

rules.title: A schema that declares an older JSON Schema draft
rules.detects: $schema naming draft-04, draft-06 or draft-07.
rules.fix: Write schemas in JSON Schema 2020-12.

claude-api.says: The docs say schemas must be valid JSON Schema 2020-12; a draft-07 $schema declaration did not stop the connector.

cases.report: monday: search, get_board_info and create_items declare draft-07; Claude through Anthropic's connector passed the job

claude-code.label: likely

rules.title: A tool's full name over 128 characters in Claude Code
rules.detects: mcp__<server name>__<tool name> longer than 128 characters (server name from --server-name).
rules.fix: Shorten the tool name.

claude-code.label: likely

rules.title: A tool declares outputSchema

claude-ai.label: likely
claude-ai.says: Open issue: tools that declare outputSchema are rejected.

claude-api.label: advisory
claude-api.says: Results are validated against it; a mismatch rejects the whole result (RESULT-SCHEMA).

cases.report: a CRM's deals read

rules.fix: Mark read tools readOnlyHint: true.

rules.title: A result that does not match the tool's own outputSchema
rules.detects: A read call's structuredContent validated against the tool's outputSchema.
rules.fix: Make the schema match what the server returns (for example allow null), or return what the schema says.

rules.title: A result over a client's documented limit
rules.detects: The size of each read result against each client's documented limit.
rules.fix: Page results or offer filters and totals.

claude-code.label: likely
claude-code.says: Warns above 10,000 output tokens and cuts at 25,000 by default (MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS).

rules.title: A call slower than a client's documented limit
rules.detects: The time of each read call against each client's documented limit.
rules.fix: Answer faster, or return early and page.

rules.title: Bytes in a result that are not valid UTF-8
rules.detects: Each read result's bytes decoded as UTF-8.
rules.fix: Encode every string as UTF-8.

openai-api.label: advisory
openai-api.says: OpenAI's client times out (504) on such results: minutes per task instead of seconds.

cases.report: a CRM's metadata read with Latin-1 bytes: three unfixed runs took 131–254 s with five 504s; re-encoded, 9–11 s

rules.title: OpenAI's MCP 2026-07-28 opening is answered with an error
rules.detects: server/discover with the Mcp-Method header, as OpenAI's client sent it on 2026-10-16, through the owner's public URL.
rules.fix: Forward all mcp-* headers through every proxy and gateway in front of the server.

openai-api.label: advisory
openai-api.says: An error there is where OpenAI's client stops (424 before any tool call).

cases.report: our own proxy dropped Mcp-Method: the vendor's server answered -32020, OpenAI reported 424

openai-api.note: Our only case is our own proxy, not a vendor's server; how OpenAI treats a server that does not speak 2026-07-28 is unknown.
